4.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
4.text: "We have been recently condemned by a number of ATO member states for our invasion of Pales."

9.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
9.text: "However, your meeting with Prime Minister Alvarez was very fruitful. I am not sure if we can trust him to veto the sanctions -- but he's our best bet in averting a major crisis."

13.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
13.text: "In your meeting with Prime Minister Alvarez, he threatened to approve the sanctions as well. Unfortunately, all of this would be a crippling blow for our trade."

29.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
29.text: "I'd like to first congratulate you for receiving a promise from Prime Minister Alvarez on supporting us at the MITZ vote."

30.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
30.text: "I'd like to first congratulate you for brokering a deal with Prime Minister Alvarez."
30.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_WillVoteYes_MITZ"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_PromiseITZSupport_Late"] == true)

31.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
31.text: "We are slowly normalizing our relations with Lespia. Your meeting with Prime Minister Alvarez was very helpful."
31.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_WillVoteYes_MITZ"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_PromiseITZSupport_Late"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_LespiaATO"] == true)

32.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
32.text: "Our relations with Lespia are deteriorating rapidly. Our meeting with Prime Minister Alvarez didn't exactly go as planned."
32.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_WillVoteYes_MITZ"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Lespia_PromiseITZSupport_Late"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_LespiaATO"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Lespia_Friendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Lespia_Allied"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_ScrewedOverLespia"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_HighExtraction"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Zille_Publicized_LespianInvolvement"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_LespiaPipelineAccess"] == true) == false)

33.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
33.text: "However, your decision to lease Caleqabiz to ATO, I believe, has sparked some outrage within Rizia."

34.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
34.text: "It is of course welcomed by Arcasia and the ATO as a whole."

35.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
35.text: "This move aligns us directly with the ATO -- which presents a new direction for our foreign policy. This will in turn antagonize countries aligned with the CSP."

36.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
36.text: "We've also received word that, as part of our deal, the pipeline extension to Lespia is already underway and continues without problems."

40.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
40.text: "Chancellor Hegel has already condemned the decision."

41.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
41.text: "On the other hand, LesPower has been supplying us with energy since our deal was signed."
41.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_LespiaPipelineAccess"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_LespiaATO"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_LesPower_Buy_HighPrices"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_LesPower_Buy_CheapPrices"] == true)

42.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
42.text: "Lespia is an important partner and a potential threat. We must tread carefully with them."
42.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_LespiaPipelineAccess"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_LespiaATO"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_LesPower_Buy_HighPrices"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_LesPower_Buy_CheapPrices"] == true) == false)

43.speaker: Player_Romus
43.text: "Great news. I hope to see some great returns in the future."

45.speaker: Player_Romus
45.text: "This will surely help our standing with them."

46.speaker: Player_Romus
46.text: "I am already aware of this, Mr. Esquibel."

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "Honestly, I don't trust them one bit. We should always expect the worst."

50.speaker: Player_Romus
50.text: "That's not good. We cannot risk any confrontation with Valgsland."

51.speaker: Player_Romus
51.text: "Of course he did. Frankly, we shouldn't care less. They were, and will never be, on our side."

52.speaker: Player_Romus
52.text: "This is good news. Having some support from Arcasia puts us in a good spot. We should try to use this to our advantage."

53.speaker: Player_Romus
53.text: "Giving Caleqabiz to ATO was a difficult decision to make. We should watch them carefully. Remember, Arcasia or their satellite states are not our allies."

54.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
54.text: "Exactly, Your Majesty. This can open up many doors for us. Especially to Western Merkopa."

58.speaker: Lucita Azaro
58.text: "This is a good position to be in but we should tread lightly on that road. Arcasia cannot be trusted."

59.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
59.text: "Once you enter from that door, there is no turning back. Arcasia doesn't help anyone because they're nice -- they're after total domination."

63.speaker: Sal Ignacius
63.text: "I agree. They stand against almost every value that we cherish in Rizia."

64.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
64.text: "I'm concerned about that too. I hope they don't create problems for us."

65.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
65.text: "However, this in turn can open up many doors for us. Especially to Western Merkopa."

66.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
66.text: "The Malenyevist ideology has no place for our kingdom, but the CSP has been behaving pragmatically so far."

67.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
67.text: "Nevertheless, this move will alienate them further against us."

68.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
68.text: "I know how difficult it is to make that decision, Your Majesty."

69.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
69.text: "They may not be our allies, but with this move, we aligned ourselves against the CSP."

70.speaker: Sal Ignacius
70.text: "I wouldn't trust them. They stand against almost every value that we cherish in Rizia."

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "We expected this to happen. This is not a surprise for us."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "Don't worry -- this will be a bigger blow for their own economy than us. You'll see."

74.speaker: Player_Romus
74.text: "They'll come running back to us as soon as we claim our victory."

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "I'm sure he'll respect the deal but he's not our friend."

77.speaker: Player_Romus
77.text: "If he acts reckless -- this will be a bigger blow for their own economy than us. Especially after we claim our victory."

78.speaker: Player_Romus
78.text: "Really? Arcasia has many values that are inspirational to me."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "Yes. They are not only a threat to our monarchy but to the whole world."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "Don't worry. I don't trust Arcasia or the ATO."

82.speaker: Elena Werner
82.text: "Their story of economic development is definitely inspiring."

94.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
94.text: "Well, in any case... If they decide to make a move, they'll likely time it with the upcoming Alliance of Nations session."

95.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
95.text: "We may have a chance to have a word with Mr. Alvarez again there. Or possibly even Mr. Reinhart."

96.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
96.text: "Another important point is our scheduled meeting with the Wehzek president."

97.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
97.text: "Your Majesty will have a chance to talk to President Smolak about the situation with Zille."

101.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
101.text: "He may bring up yet another unexpected request or 'security issue'. Regardless of his theatrics, we should do our best to reach a final resolution to ensure the swift return of Zille."

102.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
102.text: "He has been uncooperative and we don't know if we can still reach a resolution with him to ensure the return of Zille."

103.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
103.text: "If all else fails, we can bring it up in the upcoming Alliance of Nations session."

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "All means are to be considered to get Zille back."

106.speaker: Player_Romus
106.text: "It doesn't matter what President Smolak thinks or does. Zille belongs to us."

107.speaker: Player_Romus
107.text: "Thank you for the advice, Mr. Esquibel."

112.speaker: Lucita Azaro
112.text: "We will get it back, Your Majesty."

113.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
113.text: "We will certainly get it back, Your Majesty."

122.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
122.text: "Unfortunately, we couldn't export the promised amount of energy to Wehlen and our energy deal broke down. He will likely use this against us."

125.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
125.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Friendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Allied"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Derdia"] == true) == false

126.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
126.text: "On the other hand, our trade relations with Morella are very positive."
126.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Morella_Hostile"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Morella_Unfriendly"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn05_ITZVote_StatusQuo"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Morella_Friendly"] == true)

130.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
130.text: "On the other hand, our relations with our southern neighbors are still not very positive."

131.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
131.text: "The final vote on the MITZ issue, which will take place at the start of the next year, will be the defining factor for our long-term relations with them."

133.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
133.text: "Our relations with Derdia, on the other hand, have blossomed after your visit."
133.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Friendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Allied"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Derdia"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn07_DerdianDiplomaticVisit"] == true)

134.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
134.text: "Our relations with Derdia, on the other hand, have not changed much since your meeting with Grand Wiseman Azmal."
134.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Friendly"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Allied"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Derdia"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn07_DerdianDiplomaticVisit"] == true)

138.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
138.text: "Our support with building a pipeline between them and Morella gained us respect from both sides, but their disagreements with Wehlen still remain a major concern."

139.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
139.text: "Their disputes with Morella and Wehlen still remain a major concern."

140.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
140.text: "The fact that both of our nations are supporting the Bludish Freedom Front definitely factors into our relations."

144.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
144.text: "Our continued support of Wehlen's anti-Golcondist terrorist operations definitely factors into our relations."

151.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
151.text: "On the other hand, despite our trade, our relations with Morella are still not very positive."

152.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
152.text: "Our stance on the MITZ seems to have alienated them. Unfortunately Chancellor Hegel seem to have enormous influence on Prime Minister Saltana."

156.speaker: Player_Romus
156.text: "It is unfortunate that she isn't willing to compromise. I would have preferred to have good relations with Morella."

157.speaker: Player_Romus
157.text: "We knew this from the beginning. Chancellor Hegel is the real mastermind of this whole charade, and unfortunately he succeeded in sowing discord in the region already."

158.speaker: Player_Romus
158.text: "I couldn't care less. I will not let them toy with our national interests."

159.speaker: Player_Romus
159.text: "We should do our best to normalize our relations with them. Nothing is a done deal."

160.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
160.text: "Now that you have the word of Mr. Alvarez, we should be able to resolve this whole process once and for all."

161.speaker: Player_Romus
161.text: "Great. This whole MITZ thing has taken too long already."

162.speaker: Player_Romus
162.text: "At this point, I couldn't care less about our relations with them. I'm not doing this to pick a side."

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "What's more important is that we get a result that is in our national interests. That will be my priority."

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "I hate to put my trust on Mr. Alvarez on this but we will see what happens soon enough."

168.speaker: Narrator
168.text: He stopped for a moment to take a look at this notes.

169.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
169.text: "Oh. Also Supreme Wiseman Azmal sent us a letter, expressing gratitude to Rizia for showcasing 'some level of empathy', as he puts it, towards our Golcondist community."
169.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_GolcondistBlasphemy"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Happy"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Friendly"] == true) == false)

173.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
173.text: "Oh. Also Supreme Wiseman Azmal sent us a letter, praising the 'divinely ordained changes,' as he puts it, that have helped our Golcondist community."

174.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
174.text: "Oh. Also Supreme Wiseman Azmal sent us a letter of condemnation, criticizing what he calls our 'continued oppression against Golcondists' in Rizia."
174.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_GolcondistBlasphemy"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Happy"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Friendly"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Happy"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Friendly"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Allied"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Derdia"] == false)

175.speaker: Player_Romus
175.text: "I'm not going to take advice from a heretic who distorts our faith to reach their dark aims. May the Divine God save his soul."

179.speaker: Player_Romus
179.text: "I'm not going to take advice from someone who calls themselves the 'Supreme Wiseman'."

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "While I respect their efforts in reaching Golconda, I don't need the sympathy of a heretic. May the Divine God save their souls."

186.speaker: Player_Romus
186.text: "I don't need the gratitude of anyone who calls himself a 'Supreme Wiseman'."

192.speaker: Sal Ignacius
192.text: "May the Divine guide them to light."

193.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
193.text: "And last but not least... Pales. But Your Majesty is already aware of the situation with Duke Reinhart."
193.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_GolcondistBlasphemy"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Dissatisfied"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Happy"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Friendly"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_GolcondistCommunity_Happy"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Friendly"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Derdia_Allied"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Derdia"] == false) == false)

203.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
203.text: "While the superpowers have only cursorily acknowledged our invasion thus far, we're getting more and more attention from Merkopa as the operation progresses."

204.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
204.text: "The royal wedding shall take place after your upcoming visit to the Alliance of Nations."

205.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
205.text: "I want to take this opportunity to congratulate Her Highness and His Majesty once again."

211.speaker: Player_Romus
211.text: "Save your congratulations for Vina when you see her. I know she's eagerly anticipating the wedding."

212.speaker: Player_Romus
212.text: "This will open the path to our reunification with Pales."

213.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
213.text: "Indeed, Your Majesty. We are expecting talks to begin soon after the marital alliance is sealed."

214.speaker: Narrator
214.text: Laurento bowed his head respectfully before continuing.

215.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
215.text: "We have had a very stable relationship with the Grand Duchy since we signed our deal."
215.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Pales"] == true)

216.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
216.text: "Since our last interactions with the Grand Duchy, its reliance on Lespia has only grown."
216.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Pales"] == true) == false)

217.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
217.text: "This has in turn brought Pales closer to Arcasia and ATO, which I fear will significantly disrupt the balance of power in our region."

222.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
222.text: "Additionally, our recent military alliance with Pales has taken our relationship to daring new heights."

226.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
226.text: "So far, the PaleStream pipeline has also been very beneficial for both of our countries. It is a remarkable achievement."

230.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
230.text: "However, we failed to stop Duke Reinhart's close cooperation with Lespia. Despite our deals, his reliance on Lespia has only grown."
230.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Pales_MilitaryAlliance"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_PalesPipeline_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GRACEApplication"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_LowExtraction"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == false)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Pales_MilitaryAlliance"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == false)

232.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
232.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_LowExtraction"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == false)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Pales_MilitaryAlliance"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == false

233.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
233.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_LowExtraction"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == false)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Pales_MilitaryAlliance"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == false) == false

234.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
234.text: "Thanks to our combined efforts, we've successfully managed to draw Pales away from Lespia and towards us."
234.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Pales_MilitaryAlliance"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_PalesPipeline_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GRACEApplication"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_AureusField_LowExtraction"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_AureusField_Extractions"] == false)  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Pales_MilitaryAlliance"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == false) == false)

235.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
235.text: "We struck a serious blow to Lespia's interests in Pales by decreasing their reliance to them and opening their way into GRACE."
235.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Pales_MilitaryAlliance"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Economy_PalesPipeline_Completed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GRACEApplication"] == true)

236.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
236.text: "Our support of their application has already been approved by the other member states."

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "I will not stop until we achieve full reunification."

240.speaker: Player_Romus
240.text: "Keep up the good work, Mr. Esquibel. We wouldn't have achieved this without you."

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "That's not great. We can't let Pales fall into the hands of the ATO."

242.speaker: Player_Romus
242.text: "We must find other ways to approach this before it's too late."

243.speaker: Player_Romus
243.text: "Thanks for letting me know, Mr. Esquibel."

260.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
260.text: "I would not call it 'full' reunification as long as the Reinharts are calling the shots, Your Majesty."

267.speaker: Player_Romus
267.text: "That's not good news. We can't let Pales fall into the hands of the ATO."

268.speaker: Player_Romus
268.text: "We must find other ways to approach this before it's too late."

269.speaker: Player_Romus
269.text: "Thanks for letting me know, Mr. Esquibel."

271.speaker: Narrator
271.text: He bowed his head in respect.

275.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
275.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Media_Geopolitico_Support"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Good"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn06_MediaCampaign_Midsize"] == true) == false

276.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
276.text: "Our efforts in influencing the international media are paying off. Particularly in democratic countries, where citizens are pressuring their governments to back us."

277.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
277.text: "I suspect additional condemnations and sanctions may follow. We'll find out during the upcoming Alliance of Nations session, I'm sure."
277.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Media_Geopolitico_Support"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_GlobalImage_Good"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Decision_Turn06_MediaCampaign_Midsize"] == true) == false

278.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
278.text: "Still, I suspect additional condemnations and sanctions will follow. We'll find out in the upcoming Alliance of Nations session, I'm sure."

279.speaker: Lucita Azaro
279.text: "Pales will soon pay for everything. I'm expecting our first operation to come to a successful conclusion in the next months."
279.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Used_ExperimentalWeapons"] > 2) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Used_ExperimentalWeapons"] > 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_Pales_Operation1_Won"] == true) == false)

280.speaker: Lucita Azaro
280.text: "Once our armies have surrounded their capital, we'll be able to bring a quick end to this war. Assuming the Duke is a logical man."

287.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
287.text: "Unfortunately, the Palesian media's exposé on our use of experimental weapons from Rumburg has the potential to turn the international community against us."

288.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
288.text: "Unfortunately, the international community will likely unite against us, now that our repeated use of experimental weapons from Rumburg has been made public by Palesian journalists."

289.speaker: Lucita Azaro
289.text: "They're fools if they swallow that one-sided coverage. We were completely within our right to do what we did."

290.speaker: Narrator
290.text: She looked angry but full of resolve.

292.speaker: Lucita Azaro
292.text: "We'll discuss the details in a separate military briefing, Your Majesty."

294.speaker: Player_Romus
294.text: "I'm looking forward to some good news. I hope I didn't make a mistake by granting the Azaros full authority over the operation."

298.speaker: Player_Romus
298.text: "Good. I'll need your input. Managing the generals has been very stressful."

306.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
306.text: "That is all for the overview, Your Majesty."
306.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Intermerkopum_Counter"] >= 2) == false) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_TradeDeal_Pales"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.CountryRelation_Pales_Friendly"] == true) or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Pales_MilitaryAlliance"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Axel"] == true)  and 360.text: "I truly believe that our national interests align with those of our neighbors. And if we can connect our economies further and create balanced dependencies on each other..."

361.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
361.text: "We can ensure peace and unity in Southern Merkopa."

362.speaker: Player_Romus
362.text: "Do you think we can realistically form our own alliance in Southern Merkopa? How would the superpowers react to that?"

363.speaker: Player_Romus
363.text: "I completely agree with that, Mr. Esquibel. How do you think we can proceed with this idea?"

364.speaker: Player_Romus
364.text: "I think this might be going a little too far. We are not ready to clash with the superpowers."

365.speaker: Player_Romus
365.text: "I don't think we are ready to go to that level with our neighbors yet. We shouldn't disturb power dynamics by forming our separate pact."

367.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
367.text: "This isn't about clashing with them. This is about offering an alternative for peace, and protecting the interests of Southern Merkopa."

368.speaker: Player_Romus
368.text: "You are right, Mr. Esquibel. I think we should at least try to get our neighbors together. How do you think we can proceed with this idea?"

369.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
369.text: "They will not like it, of course. But what can they really do if we all come together to protect our independence?"

370.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
370.text: "If we can lead such a peace initiative, I think this is realistically possible. It is all about ensuring that our countries are linked in a fundamental level that makes cutting ties a losing scenario for everyone."

371.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
371.text: "This is the only way to bring together countries with vastly different ideologies and cultures like we have in Southern Merkopa."

372.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
372.text: "We can lead the initiative to form a neutral Southern Merkopan pact. This would require us to funnel a lot of resources into it."

373.speaker: Player_Romus
373.text: "That's a risk I'm willing to take. It's about time for us to begin pulling away from GRACE, anyway."

374.speaker: Player_Romus
374.text: "I don't believe connecting our economies and creating such dependencies will be good for anyone. It may fuel conflicts in the future and will give undue power to the countries with higher control over the most valuable resources."

375.speaker: Player_Romus
375.text: "On second thought, I will not proceed with this. Now is not the right time."

376.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
376.text: "Well, Your Majesty. In case of a conflict, we will be the ones holding the keys. Such an alliance will only put Rizia in a stronger position."

377.speaker: Player_Romus
377.text: "I don't think so, Mr. Esquibel. Should we proceed with this idea, I predict catastrophe for the future of the region."

378.speaker: Player_Romus
378.text: "I see what you're getting at. Clever."

379.speaker: Player_Romus
379.text: "You're the expert. If you think this plan is in the best interests of Rizia, I will not argue with you."

381.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
381.text: "We can start the process by reaching out to our neighbors and preemptively funneling some funds into leading this initiative."

383.speaker: Player_Romus
383.text: "Yes. I want this alliance to happen."

385.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
385.text: "As you wish, Your Majesty. I will keep you updated as developments occur."

425.text: "Feel free to take some time off the council if the pressure is too much for you."

427.speaker: Narrator
427.text: Vina smiled weakly and said nothing.

429.speaker: Player_Romus
429.text: "He'd better be. We're giving him enough in return."

430.speaker: Player_Romus
430.text: "That's very good to hear, Your Highness."

431.speaker: Player_Romus
431.text: "So when will we able to proceed with the reunification talks?"

432.speaker: Vina Toras
432.text: "Soon after the wedding. Assuming it all goes smoothly, of course."

433.speaker: Vina Toras
433.text: "As we should, Father. Axel's family has been championing Palesian independence for 30 years. Handing over the reins is not something he takes lightly."

434.speaker: Vina Toras
434.text: "We will have to wait until after the wedding to proceed with reunification talks. But I'm expecting the process to go smoothly."

435.speaker: Narrator
435.text: Vina blushed. Laurento bowed his head respectfully before continuing.

436.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
436.text: "Thank you for laying the groundwork, Your Highness. Duke Reinhart is a lucky man indeed."

437.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
437.text: "As are we all. I expect that Palesian-Rizian reunification talks will begin soon after the marital alliance is sealed."

438.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
438.text: "I expect that Palesian-Rizian reunification talks will begin soon after the marital alliance is sealed."

439.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
439.text: "But it is better than Lespia doing the same."

440.speaker: Lucita Azaro
440.text: "That may not be possible as long as the Reinharts are in charge. But we've made significant strides forward."

441.speaker: Elena Werner
441.text: "That will depend on the outcome of next year's final MITZ board vote. I'm hoping for no last-minute surprises."

442.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
442.text: "But it does come at the risk of alienating Rumburg. Queen Beatrice may see such an alliance as an affront to GRACE, especially at a time when her kingdom is facing increasing geopolitical isolation."

443.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
443.text: "Our relations with Derdia, on the other hand, have soured since we refused the opportunity for a diplomatic visit."

450.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
450.text: "Our relations with Derdia remain amicable, despite the fact that we refused to meet with Supreme Wiseman Azmal."

457.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
457.text: "On the other hand, our relations with Morella has mostly been normalized."
